title: Security / deploy∈docker root-equivalence remediated + VPS Final Gate verified read-only on-host (2026-08-20)

metadata.title: ops(vps-admin): permanent least-privilege VPS administration model

observations.statement: TEST (2026-08-20): from the owner Windows machine, `ssh deploy@51.68.226.211` with key ~/.ssh/vps_ovh_ed25519 succeeds non-interactively (BatchMode). NOTE: the ~/.ssh/config `mythos` alias points at id_ed25519_vps_ovh, whose public key is NOT authorized on the host (Permission denied) — use vps_ovh_ed25519 explicitly. This is the documented owner-machine channel (DEPLOYMENT_READINESS.md) and it is now exercised directly from a session. It does NOT restore access for the isolated AI container — the VPS-PATH finding still holds for that environment.

TEST (2026-08-20, on-host as deploy): the prior CONFIRMED HIGH deploy∈docker root-equivalence is REMEDIATED. `id -nG deploy` = 'deploy users' (no docker); `getent group docker` = 'docker:x:986:' (memberless); /var/run/docker.sock is srw-rw---- root:docker and `docker ps` is denied to deploy. Remediation shipped by owner commit 2f1f983, on origin/main via merge 149dbae.

TEST (2026-08-20, on-host): removing docker introduced no substitute root-equivalent path. deploy sudo = exactly `/usr/sbin/nginx -t`, `/usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx`, `/usr/bin/certbot`. The installed 50-mythosadmin sudoers contains no file-copier, interpreter, editor, container runtime, or arbitrary systemctl. The audited mythos-deploy tool resolves targets from a fixed registry and lists `status` (Status Center) as PROTECTED/refused; it runs git as the deploy owner (root never writes the repo).

TEST (2026-08-20, on-host as deploy): governance boundary intact ON-HOST (not only in-container). /etc/mythos/governance.key = root:mythos-gov 0640 with EACCES as deploy; approvals store EACCES; tests/mythos-governance-invariant-test.js = 99 passed / 0 failed run on the host.

TEST (2026-08-20, on-host): tests/mos-e2e-lifecycle-test.js hard-refuses on the registered production checkout ('run only in an isolated container') — a deliberate safety property. Live on-host E2E is therefore intentionally not runnable against the prod checkout; the in-container proof (54/0) is the record. Do not override the refusal.

TEST (2026-08-20, on-host): /home/deploy/othk-store is ABSENT and projects/mythos-ai-executor/config/knowledge.json is fail-closed (enabled=false, store_root=null). Per docs/PRIVATE_STORE_ARCHITECTURE.md, store provisioning is an owner/operator action with the location still a pending owner decision, and Track B needs owner-produced authorized exports — no AI session performs either. This is the first genuine owner block after VPS-GATE + DOCKER-FIX went green.
